description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView, which manages user interactions for setting and resetting voice wake words. It allows adding, removing, and editing trigger words, and saves/sanitizes the list via VoiceWakePreferences, updating the app model accordingly.

classes.name: VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for managing voice wake words, including adding, deleting, resetting, and syncing with preferences and app model.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout, including form sections, buttons, and event handling.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Appends an empty string to the trigger words list, prompting user input.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets and resets defaults if list becomes empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Creates a binding to a trigger word at a given index for editing.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves, sanitizes, and propagates the trigger words to preferences and app model.
